events.title: Research begins
events.body: [Draft] G&A Institute starts its annual analysis of S&P 500 sustainability reporting.

events.title: Coverage expanded
events.body: [Draft] From 2018, G&A also tracks the full Russell 1000 and its smallest half by market cap.

events.title: Methodology updated
events.body: From 2024, only reports published within the year are counted (previously a two-year window).
